sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Stafford Town on Saturday 28 November, looking to extend their excellent recent form. Sandbach's last five league results show two wins, two losses, and a most recent win, leaving them top of the table with 37 points from 17 games. Stafford, currently fourth with 32 points, have been inconsistent lately with one loss in their last six league matches.
divisionWide: Tuesday evening sees Alsager Town host Barnton in a mid-table clash, with Barnton enjoying fine form (four wins in their last six) while Alsager struggle near the bottom. The Saturday fixtures feature a compelling top-four battle: second-placed Wolverhampton Casuals, currently on a remarkable six-game winning streak, face struggling Dawley Town at home. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth travel to Cheadle Heath Nomads, a side fighting to climb out of the bottom half. Eccleshall, sitting fifth, host Barnton in a fixture between two in-form teams. Mid-table sides Allscott Heath welcome Crewe, while Brereton Social host Alsager Town in a low-confidence clash. New Mills travel to Foley Meir, both sides searching for consistency, and Wednesfield Community host Shawbury United at the bottom end of the table. Telford Town face Widnes Town in a fixture between the two lowest-ranked sides in the division.
